interpretation: 公开签名、受管路由、组件与原生证据分开记录。实际记录见 docs/development/browser-native-acceptance.md；publicMembers.nativeAcceptance 表示完整逐项原生验收矩阵，当前250项仍未逐项完成该矩阵，局部原生通过不将其标为通过。nativeCases 只关联仓库中按 coverage 标明范围的用例定义，不代表该成员的权限、失效、取消或支持平台矩阵已全部验收；实际执行版本与结果由开发记录维护。

client.scope: 客户端目标绑定、Locator/Frame/等待器/WebMCP描述与输入安全；不代表原生浏览器实现

loopback.scope: 真实Node WebSocket握手、profile/generation、分片/hash/迟到结果与持久身份

core.scope: 实际Core PackageLoader/Registry/SQLite/RunEngine五类贡献、运行资源、争用、取消、真实native-fixture detach、AX混合MCP图片、下载列表、身份及大小检查、排队期限

mv3.scope: 真实MV3路由代码、替代Chrome API fixture；非Chrome/Edge实装证据

files.scope: 真实本机文件与原生bytes/Blob的权限、固定快照、完整性、no-replace和取消屏障

remaining: 浏览器下载列表允许 AI 选择未自动关联的文件；部分异步生成、跨 frame 下载仍不承诺自动关联，不能按 URL/时间冒充确定身份
用户现有浏览器环境接入及 Chrome、Edge 在全部支持系统和多配置下的完整验收
B001–B148与X001–X102逐项支持环境、失败路径和精确修订验收
高阶资产、站点导出、用户接管及可视化的完整真实环境、格式与失效路径验收
正式公共协议包、npm/browser制品发行与端到端Host媒体交付

native-browser-download-records-resource.test: native browser download records expose completed file paths for MCP resources

native-background-cursor.test: native background cursor movement settles without a paint callback and leaves no control after run cleanup

native-screenshot-pixels.test: native screenshot maxEdgePx bounds physical JPEG pixels at multiple device scales

native-organization-state.test: native window/tab/group/bookmark management exposes and changes actual isolated browser state

native-organization-scope.test: native organization mutations cannot alter a window or group whose member is controlled by another run

native-independent-profiles.test: native independent browser profiles keep control, conflicts and offline identities isolated

native-ax-result-modes.test: native AX read and write modes preserve typed MCP output, current authority and historical bytes

native-element-screenshot-scroll.test: native element screenshots capture the actual scrolled target at multiple device scales

native-ax-text-diff.test: native AX text emits scoped bounded diffs and screenshots preserve its observation baseline

native-ax-write-diff.test: native AX write delivers real state diffs and honors forced full and combined image modes

native-dialog-values.test: native Dialog descriptors accept prompts, dismiss confirmations and reject consumed identities

native-dialog-completion.test: native confirm acceptance and prompt dismissal preserve real values and consumed identities

native-tab-input-aliases.test: native Tab focus hover keyboard and scroll aliases produce actual events, coordinates and fixed-ref rejection

native-locator-positions.test: native last locators observe empty and later matching elements without losing order

native-disabled-controls.test: native enabled state respects fieldsets and inherited aria without dispatching disabled actions

native-text-matching.test: native text locators normalize whitespace and find button values without matching scripts

native-locator-operations.test: native Locator queries, combinations, keyboard, checkbox and selection change actual DOM state

native-role-name-priority.test: native role names prefer referenced labels over aria-label and match the browser accessibility tree

native-locator-held.test: native registered Locator state/metadata and held all() refs remain accurate through actual keyboard and DOM mutations

native-locator-frame-scope.test: native descendant Locator and Frame query families retain their actual scope across nested documents

native-media-navigation.test: native fixed refs, element geometry and three media entry points use actual image bytes and reject replaced observations

native-peer-metadata.test: native capability revisions, browser identity, tab metadata and packaged documentation describe the actual peer

native-viewport-follow.test: native visibility follows the selected target and viewport aliases change and reset actual page dimensions

native-ax-cua-dom-actions.test: native AX, CUA and fixed DOM actions change real controls and preserve native input semantics

native-clipboard-ax.test: native multiple-MIME ClipboardItem and AX Markdown paste/secondary actions preserve actual browser data

native-assets-export.test: native page inventories, embedded SVG, partial downloads, real PDF/HTML/Markdown and temporary batch pages produce fixed files

native-filechooser.test: native file chooser accepts multiple path/byte attachments and a failed preflight leaves selection unchanged

native-cross-site-frame.test: native Frame and nested FrameLocator operate inside a cross-site OOPIF using high-level methods

native-dialog-aliases.test: native dialogAccept and dialogDismiss aliases consume the actual prompt, confirm and alert identities

native-file-refs-waiters.test: native direct file refs, owned download aliases and waiter cancellation keep real identities

native-local-blob-resource.test: native Blob download keeps its identity and becomes an MCP resource

native-local-data-resource.test: native data URL download keeps its identity and becomes an MCP resource

native-generated-download-resource.test: native direct HTTP links and synchronously generated Blob links retain their own downloads

native-download-other-tab.test: native same-URL download in another tab keeps its normal filename

native-download-earlier-request.test: native download started before a new wait keeps its original filename

native-dev-console-logs.test: native dev logs normalize real console warnings and apply filter, limit and since without replaying older entries

native-cdp-beforeunload.test: native beforeunload dialogs can be dismissed and CDP cursors read actual bounded ordered events

native-tab-close.test: native closing an attached tab preserves the same run's other tab for both close entry points

native-explicit-handoff.test: native explicit handoff closes the original waiter and prevents same-run reacquisition without affecting another tab

native-takeover-continuation.test: native explicit input continuation issues a new tab epoch, rejects old handles and leaves another controlled tab intact

native-takeover-negative.test: native declined, cancelled, expired and revoked continuations never renew browser control

native-page-and-download-resource.test: native MV3 provides page interaction, MCP JPEG and an actual downloaded MCP resource

native-google-docs-export.test: native public Google Docs exports real DOCX, PDF and Markdown through the content and convenience entry points

native-youtube-export.test: native public YouTube transcript exports match the actual rendered cues through both SDK entry points

native-webmcp-registration.test: native WebMCP either invokes real document registrations with exact revisions or reports its actual unsupported reason

native-webmcp-direct-facade.test: native WebMCP either invokes real document registrations with exact revisions or reports its actual unsupported reason

native-scroll-press-wait.test: native AX and DOM scroll, Tab press and waitForTimeout produce observable effects

native-debugger-cancel-linux.test: actual native debugger Cancel ends the current control lease and original waiter

native-visual-feedback.test: native visual feedback preserves user groups, follows only when enabled and releases the real result marker on tab activation
